meta.name: prompt-master
meta.description: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出让AI更懂你的提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果对着AI工具总说不清需求，想得到更精准的回答
copy.tagline_en: Write prompts that AI understands better
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to express needs clearly to AI tools

howto.what: 收到写或改提示词的要求时,Claude 会当提示词工程师:先确认目标 AI 工具、提炼意图,再给出一条可直接粘贴的优化提示词,并附目标工具和优化点说明;必要时至多问 3 个澄清问题。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求为某个 AI 工具(如 LLM、Cursor、Midjourney 等)编写、修复、改进或改写提示词时触发;普通聊天、写文档、编程不触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Midjourney 提示词改得更准确
say.note: Claude 会先确认目标工具再重写提示词。

say.text: 为 Cursor 写一条生成登录页组件的提示词
say.note: 会输出可直接粘贴的提示词块。

say.text: 帮我改进给 GPT 用的提示词,加上输出格式要求
say.note: 会自动补全关键字段并说明优化点。

howto.what_en: When asked to write or improve a prompt, Claude acts as a prompt engineer: identifies the target AI tool, extracts intent, outputs a ready-to-paste optimized prompt with a short target note; may ask up to 3 clarifying questions.
howto.when_en: Only triggers when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, etc.). Not for general chat, documents, or coding.

say_en.text: Make this Midjourney prompt more accurate in style.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the tool, then rewrites it.

say_en.text: Write a Cursor prompt to generate a login page component.
Fix my GPT prompt and add an output format section.
say_en.note: It fills in key fields and explains the optimization.
